source_text: XIII. Ταῦτα οὖν μετὰ τοσούτου τάχους ἐγένετο, θᾶττον ἢ ἐλέγετο, τῶν ὄχλων παραχρῆμα συναγόντων ἔκ τε τῶν ἐργαστηρίων καὶ βαλανείων ξύλα καὶ φρύγανα, μάλιστα Ἰουδαίων προθύμως, ὡς ἔθος αὐτοῖς, εἰς ταῦτα ὑπουργούντων. Ὅτε δὲ ἡ πυρὰ ἡτοιμάσθη, ἀποθέμενος ἑαυτῷ πάντα τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λύσας τὴν ζώνην, ἐπειρᾶτο καὶ ὑπολύειν ἑαυτόν, μὴ πρότερον τοῦτο ποιῶν διὰ τὸ ἀεὶ ἕκαστον τῶν πιστῶν σπουδάζειν, ὅστις τάχιον τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ ἅψηται. Ἐν παντὶ γὰρ ἀγαθῆς ἕνεκεν πολιτείας καὶ πρὸ τῆς μαρτυρίας ἐκεκόσμητο. Εὐθέως οὖν αὐτῷ περιετίθετο τὰ πρὸς τὴν πυρὰν ἡρμοσμένα ὄργανα. Μελλόντων δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ προσηλοῦν εἶπεν· Ἄφετέ με οὕτως· ὁ γὰρ δοὺς ὑπομεῖναι τὸ πῦρ, δώσει καὶ χωρὶς τῆς ὑμετέρας ἐκ τῶν ἥλων ἀσφαλείας ἄσχυλτον ἐπιμεῖναι τῇ πυρᾷ.
pass_a_gloss: These things then came to be with so much quickness, quicker than it was being told, with the crowds gathering on the spot both out of the workshops and baths wood and brushwood, with Jews above all readily, as is custom to them, serving toward these things. And when the pyre had been made ready, having laid aside for himself all the garments and having loosed the belt, he was trying also to unloose himself under, not doing this before because always each of the faithful was eager, whoever should touch his skin more quickly. For in everything by reason of good conduct even before the witness he had been adorned. Straightway then were being put around him the instruments fitted to the pyre. And when they were about also to nail him, he said: Leave me thus; for the one having given to abide the fire will give also apart from your safety from the nails to abide upon the pyre unmoved.
pass_b_english: So these things were done with such speed, faster than they can be told, as the crowds at once brought together timber and brushwood from the workshops and the baths, with the Jews above all eagerly lending their service to this work, as is their custom. And when the pyre was prepared, he laid aside all his garments and loosed his belt, and he tried to undress himself, which he had not done before, because each of the faithful was always in haste to be the one to touch his flesh first. For in every respect he had been adorned before his martyrdom also, on account of his good life.

Then at once the instruments prepared for the pyre were set about him, and when they were about to nail him fast he said, Leave me thus. For he who has granted me to endure the fire will also grant me to remain steady upon the pyre without the security of your nails.
